title: Emerging artist, Faron Sage releases a new track titled “Whole”
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music artist Faron Sage is a talented singer and songwriter exploring some of the pressing issues facing us today through his music. The talented star does not disappoint in releasing his recent song "Whole."

Faron Sage's "Whole" is all about the things that are conditioned and constrained by the societies that we live in, but what that does is curb the soul. "Whole" is another record that shows his style of music in the essence of getting better with time. Faron Sage's history is making magic at every turn and is genuinely in tune with his artistry to paint a picture.
